comment: What a failed run's plain error text means: signedOut (not signed in, signed out, an expired or rejected login) or limitReached (a usage or rate limit), the two that signing in to the agent's provider can fix, or null for anything else. Matching is case-insensitive on substrings, and a curly apostrophe reads as a straight one. Hosted credit, GitHub's own API and Harness's own account are never the provider's problem. A signedOut match wins over limitReached. Provider-typed reauthentication keeps its own card and is not classified here. The desktop (crates/proto/src/run_errors.rs) and the phone (RunErrors.swift) check these same cases.
